title: A completed result is seen only when its final reply enters the visible transcript

source.name: seen eligibility requires the matching outcome and its loaded result, rather than a route opening

turns.prompt: Read the result when it arrives.

steps.text: The next result is still working.

ready: Read the result when it arrives.
invariant: Opening a route and rendering an off-screen final reply never marks it seen. Bringing that exact completed reply into the visible transcript acknowledges its journal outcome once on the server; the acknowledgement survives reload.
